The 22nd annual conference — themed Innovative HRI — will be held March 8–12, 2027 in Santa Clara, CA, in the heart of Silicon Valley. Important Dates All deadlines are 23:59 AoE ( Anywhere on Earth ). HRI 2027 brings the community to the region where academic labs and the industries they created have been shaping human-robot interaction for over half a century. Industry Meets Academia Connect with engineers, researchers, and leaders from the companies defining the future of robotics. Dedicated industry talks, panel discussions, and a full Industry Day await. Explore the Bay Area Visiting Silicon Valley Stanford University Apple Park NASA Ames + Hangar One Nvidia Campus Computer History Museum 01 The Innovation Capital Santa Clara sits at the heart of Silicon Valley, minutes from the headquarters of the world's most influential tech and robotics companies. The perfect setting for HRI's most industry-connected conference yet. 02 Getting Here Fly into San Jose (SJC) or San Francisco (SFO), both with easy access to the venue. The Bay Area offers year-round mild weather, world-class dining, and iconic landmarks from the Golden Gate Bridge to Stanford. 03 Beyond the Conference Extend your trip to explore the region — visit the Computer History Museum, walk the campuses where the future is being built, or take a day trip to the coast.
